candidates.title: Extension of the Fusion Power Plant Costing Standard
candidates.notes: Extends CATF costing framework to three architecture tracks: MFE, IFE, and Magneto-Inertial Fusion Energy (MIFE), with pulsed-power systems as a cost-driver for MIFE. Methodology paper, not a specific IMG capital cost study. Does not provide IMG driver cost numbers, but establishes the costing vocabulary and framework applicable to MagLIF. Open access on arXiv.

candidates.title: A costing framework for fusion power plants
candidates.notes: Related costing framework paper; appears to be the base document that 2602.19389 extends. Not triage-checked independently given similar scope.

candidates.title: Exclusive: Here's how Pacific Fusion plans to build a fusion power plant
candidates.notes: TechCrunch article from April 15, 2025. WebFetch returned only CSS/metadata — article body not accessible (JS-rendered or paywalled). No cost data visible.

candidates.title: LLNL offers tools to model the economics of inertial fusion power plants
candidates.notes: LLNL GEM tool covers only laser IFE (DPSSL driver). No coverage of pulsed magnetic fusion, pulsed power, or MagLIF architectures. Not useful for G-1.

gaps_attempted.notes: Best available source is a costing methodology paper that introduces a MIFE cost-driver track — not the plant-specific IMG capital cost study the gap requires. No 2025-era Pacific Fusion plant economics paper found on arXiv or elsewhere in open access.

candidates.title: Integrated simulations of premagnetized and self-magnetizing dynamic screw pinch-driven MagLIF
candidates.notes: AIP Physics of Plasmas, May 2025. Directly relevant: shows self-magnetizing DSP-driven MagLIF without external field coils; 40 MA simulation shows burn-averaged Lawson parameter above unity and DT yield >1 MJ. Behind AIP paywall. No arXiv preprint found. OSTI ID 2566921 exists but purl/2566921 returns 404 (no open-access copy). ResearchGate PDF returned 403.

candidates.title: Simulated thermonuclear performance of auto-magnetizing helical liner MagLIF target implosions
candidates.notes: AIP Physics of Plasmas, April 2025. Auto-magnetizing helical liner MagLIF, >30 T axial field without external coils, higher yield than standard MagLIF. Previously identified in iter-7 as paywalled (extraction rc=1). No open-access preprint found.

candidates.title: Auto-magnetizing (AutoMag) liners for MagLIF: Helically-wound composite liners
candidates.notes: OSTI technical report, 2019. Prospective report — tests 'will soon be conducted.' Provides >30 T field specification but no fusion yield or gain data. Predates the 2025 AIP papers reporting actual simulation results. Not worth extracting.

candidates.title: Numerical investigation of magneto-inertial fusion targets magnetized by dynamic enforcement of helical current flow
candidates.notes: AIP Physics of Plasmas, July 2025. Also relevant to self-magnetizing MagLIF but behind paywall.

failed.reason: AIP paywall. OSTI purl 404. ResearchGate 403. No open-access version found.

gaps_attempted.notes: Multiple highly relevant 2025 Physics of Plasmas papers exist (DSP self-magnetizing MagLIF, AutoMag helical liner), all behind AIP paywall with no accessible preprints. Gap remains open until institutional access or author-hosted preprints become available.

candidates.title: Analysis of Preheat Propagation in MagLIF-like Plasmas
candidates.notes: arXiv, April 2025. Studies how laser preheat propagates through magnetized fuel — establishes preheat energy transport dynamics. Does NOT address eliminating preheat or laserless operation feasibility. Open access but not useful for G-13.

gaps_attempted.notes: No open-access paper found specifically addressing laser preheat elimination feasibility at commercially relevant yields. The self-magnetizing DSP work (G-11 candidates) is directly related but all behind AIP paywall. The GlobeNewsWire announcement already extracted in iter-6 remains the primary source for G-13.
